intro: Add your own geographic annotations. Coordinates stay attached to the project and are clipped to the selected map area during engraving.
importHint: Tracks and routes become trails, polygon outlines become boundaries, and waypoints become markers. Long tracks are simplified to fit.
placeMarkersTitle: Click the map to place markers
placingStatus: Click the map to add a marker. Choose Done placing when you’re finished.
markersEmpty: Place markers by clicking the map, or add one and enter its latitude and longitude, then choose the symbol to engrave.
useSvgForMarker: Use an SVG for this marker
iconAnchorGroup: {name} rests on the marker at its
iconAnchorBaseTitle: The icon's lowest point marks the spot, like a pin's tip
iconAnchorCenterTitle: The icon's middle marks the spot
removeIconTitle: Remove icon; markers using it become pins
markerNote: Markers follow the visible faces of the stack. Markers outside the selected crop remain saved but are not engraved. Uploaded SVG icons are engraved as filled shapes; strokes become outlines and white areas cut through.
drawPathTitle: Click the map to draw a path
drawStart: Click the map where the path starts.
drawFirstPoint: First point placed. Click the next point on your route.
drawFewPoints: {count, plural, one {# point placed} other {# points placed}}. Double-click or press Enter to finish a trail; from three points, clicking the first one closes a boundary.
drawManyPoints: {count, plural, one {# point placed} other {# points placed}}. Click the first point to close a boundary, or double-click or press Enter to finish a trail.
pathsEmpty: Draw a trail or boundary on the map, or add one and type its latitude and longitude points.
hidePoints: Hide {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
editPoints: Edit {count, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}
pathNeedsTwoPoints: A path needs at least two points
pathNote: Custom paths render even when built-in Trails or Boundaries are switched off.
markerIconLimit: A project holds at most {max} marker icons. Remove one before adding another.
graphicLimit: A project holds at most {max} graphics. Remove one before adding another.
graphicAdded: Graphic “{name}” added · Place it on the piece
pointOutOfRange: That point is beyond the latitudes TopoStack maps.
pathFull: This path holds as many points as it can · press Enter to finish it
boundaryTooShort: A boundary needs at least three points
trailTooShort: A trail needs at least two points · keep clicking, or press Escape to stop
chartReviewRequired: Complete contour, alignment, and layer review before saving a chart.
chartKept: Depth chart kept · use it for {lake} when you are ready
chartKeptUnnamed: Depth chart kept · use it for its lake when you are ready
chartNeedsReview: This chart needs contour, alignment, and layer review. Recreate it from the source chart before using it.
chartInUse: Depth chart in use · regenerate terrain to carve it
